[imports] test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/qg72.py: the imported function `base__m` of `qg72.py` has the same name as a function the program defines itself, and the program binds the name `base__m` itself to the imported one (a from-import, a wildcard import, or a class method reached by its mangled name): one name cannot denote both definitions, so a call of it would be verified against the wrong contract while CPython runs the other (routes #624 / #625 / #630). FIX: rename one of the two functions, or import it under a distinct name (`from mod import base__m as other`).
